issue.title: Manipur
issue.summary: Ethnic conflict between Meitei and Kuki-Zo communities since 3 May 2023, the central/state response (Biren Singh's exit, President's Rule 13 Feb 2025 to 4 Feb 2026), Supreme Court oversight, thin Parliament debate, and 2026 developments: a new Naga-Kuki front, the Tronglaobi bombing and the March 2026 arrests of an American and six Ukrainians that some commentators tie to Manipur (unverified).
issue.edition: public: confirmed, reported and disputed facts plus attributed claims. Inferred events, inferred links and hypotheses are kept in the local research edition only.
